dedupe_keys.name: rosaviatsia open data russian civil aviation statistics and aerodrome register

description: The Federal Air Transport Agency of Russia (Rosaviatsia) publishes about 30 open datasets as CSV files. They include the state register of civil aerodromes and heliports, statistics of Russian civil aviation on passengers, cargo and mail carried, passenger-kilometres, tonne-kilometres, seat occupancy, load factors, aircraft-kilometres and the number of aircraft for scheduled and non-scheduled services, passenger and cargo volumes through Russian airports, a register of transport infrastructure objects and vehicles of air transport, and administrative registers such as operator certificates, maintenance organisations, training centres and security units. Coverage is national (Russia). The datasets are free to download under the standard terms of use for public information published as open data (approved by the government commission in 2016). Caveats: the pages are in Russian, update dates vary by dataset, and several sets are administrative registers, not infrastructure data. The aerodrome register and airport traffic statistics support air network models, airport capacity planning and exposure analysis of aerodromes. They complement the ARNAD Russian aeronautical database catalogued here.
